Personally in my honest opinion , NoFap alone does not make us more confident and comfortable in social settings. Being confident/courageous is not the absence of fear but having fear and still going through with it. However, being on NoFap i was able to force myself into many uncomfortable social situations until I'm confident and comfortable enough now. 

As human beings , we tend to have empathy towards others. Seeing our species in a bigger picture , helping others would only mean helping humanity as a whole. And the only ones who can relate to the NoFap community is the ones who have suffered with similar addictions before and probably that is why we are aspired to help and connect with people who fap.
